title: Specialized Revamped The Crux Comp Carbon Model..... and I Love It!

takeaways.text: The size-54 bike weighed 8.77 kg (19 lb 6 oz) and retailed at US$4,000.
The Crux keeps a round 27.2 mm seatpost, exposed cables and a threaded bottom bracket, easy to service and to pack for travel.
For 2024 the Comp kept the FACT 10r frame, wheels and tires but moved from SRAM Apex 11-speed to mechanical Shimano GRX 12-speed.
It ships with DT Swiss G540 alloy wheels and 38 mm Pathfinder Pro tires; he suggests 42 mm S-Works Pathfinders as an upgrade.

disclosure: GC Performance is a bike shop that sells Specialized.
summary: A shop walkaround and weigh-in of the 2024 Specialized Crux Comp on the FACT 10r frame with mechanical Shimano GRX 12-speed.
